Introducing our 15 Modern Abstract and Boho Shapes, Line Art for Procreate!
These 15 modern abstract, boho line art are designed to help you create the perfect art for any occasion. Whether it’s your next work of art, a birthday card for your bestie, a new logo for your company or just a doodle on the corner of your homework; these shapes will get you there in no time.
These modern abstract shapes are perfect for procreate. They are simple and very easy to use and you can change the size to your desired scale, then tap on fill color and select your color choice. These shapes will automatically be filled in with your selected color.
Please note only some shapes can be filled in, depending on the design.
Fresh & New Shapes
These shapes are perfect for any design project, including but not limited to branding projects, invitations, posters, and more!
Abstract illustrations allow the artist to portray a full range of emotions and ideas in a manner that is not possible with realistic figurative representation. It’s an interesting way to create something visually stunning and convey more depth.
Abstract illustration is more than just an aesthetically pleasing image. That is why it is important to consider colors and their effects. There are a lot of different color schemes that work well together, some more popular than others. One example of a popular color scheme is complementary colors. These colors are opposite one another on the color wheel, but do not create the high contrast of direct opposites.
Abstract hand-drawn shapes has been a popular art form for centuries. The drawings are done on a white sheet of paper and heavily rely on the use of black ink, paint or pencils. These illustrations often depict organic shapes, geometric patterns and lines to create an optical illusion of depth.
Abstract hand-drawn shapes illustration is a style of art that’s all about feeling and emotion. The artist draws loose lines with organic shapes, usually with a black or brown pen.
Abstract Hand-drawn illustrations are a new trend in the art world. These stylized drawings are often used to convey complex, abstract meanings. They are often dream-like and surrealistic.
The art of surrealism dates back to the 1920s. But it was not until Salvador Dali’s iconic painting, The Persistence of Memory, that this genre was born. Surrealist paintings typically have a dream-like quality because they are often layered with symbolism and have a feeling of mystery about them.
